name: Telegram Desktop
author: Telegram FZ-LLC
summary: A cloud-based mobile and desktop messaging app with a focus on security and speed.

versions.release_notes:
- On-chain gifts offers and sales from your Money section.
- Memory safe and process isolated html widgets.
- Stories dafting and posting.
- Bot preview stories.
- Bug fixes and other minor improvements.
- Bug fixes and other minor improvements.
- Bug fixes and other minor improvements.

- Fix crash on launch on some Windows systems.
- Bug fixes and other minor improvements.
- HTML widgets in bots.

- Ask for camera and microphone access in mini apps on Windows and macOS.
- Fix custom download folder and other settings getting reset.
- Fix maximized window jitter on Windows.
- Fix notifications moving off screen on Windows.
- Fix missing notifications in bots with topics.
- Fix exports of migrated groups missing the old group history.
- Fix code blocks losing the indentation of their first line.
- Fix many crashes and other bugs.

- Show TON DNS gift owners as links, not address groups.
- Fix green video tint when using D3D9 backend with ANGLE on Windows.
- Fix transparent unusable media viewer with ANGLE on Windows.
- Fix inability to type '?' showing Shortcuts legend instead.

- Fix Chinese characters not showing on older Windows.
- Fix possible crash in context loss on Windows.
- Fix respecting Focus Mode on Windows.
- Fix menu translation on macOS.
- Fix several other crashes.
- Add DESKTOP_APP_DISABLE_PRIVATE_QT_API build option. (allows to build tdesktop without the need to rebuild on Qt updates at the price of feature degradation and KWindowSystem dependency)

- Reply with quotes to rich messages.
- Move your unique gifts to your Money card on the TON blockchain.
- Decorate your Money card with your unique gifts.
- QR code design for public usernames.
- Migrate to Qt 6 on Windows.

- Fix wallet encryption with Windows Hello sometimes failing.
- Fix same passcode saving in wallet encryption.
- Fix copy-restricted media reaching Downloads.
- Fix bad date colors in some custom themes.
- Remove attaching Link in photo editor.
- Money.

- Fix some more crashes with bad lottie files.

- Widen rich message bubbles to fit wide content.

- Disable gift messages for recipients who charge for messages.
